title: Correction to Maketo completeness, CorpStacking product scope and TheXRPInvestor search-only evidence

source_capture_policy.note: The correction is based on rendered publisher pages. It corrects source-completeness and scope wording only; it does not convert aggregator output into primary AP cash records or model features.

corrections.original_artifact_claim: The displayed November 4 zero needs per-fund completeness confirmation; the page says incomplete days are blank rather than zero.
corrections.corrected_claim: The rendered page explicitly reports November 4, 2026 as $0 across all five funds, and its per-fund table shows $0 for XRP, XRPZ, XRPC, GXRP and TOXR. The incomplete day is October 24, shown as 0 of 5 funds and 'Not yet'; the page explains that this missing day is blank, not zero.
limitations: The page is a third-party presentation of fund-reported daily figures; the original issuer/AP settlement payloads and raw response bytes were not preserved in this capture.
Maketo's past-month $18M is a calendar-period measure; Alpha Finance's $78.9M is labelled as 30 sessions. These are not identical windows and must not be averaged.
Maketo's $7.4M past-week measure and Alpha Finance's $4.8M last-seven-sessions measure use different window definitions and publisher series.

corrections.original_artifact_claim: The artifact represented NCIQ index ETF inclusion in the 1,414,952,215 XRP headline as true.
corrections.corrected_claim: The page's visible text does not establish whether NCIQ is included in the 1,414,952,215 XRP headline. It says multi-asset index funds including NCIQ are excluded from fund totals, yet NCIQ appears in the ten-entry 'Largest XRP holders' list; the page also describes ten funds in one section and nine spot funds in another. The headline total's exact membership is unresolved because the complete sponsor-by-sponsor table is gated.

stale_evernorth_note.page_claim: Evernorth closed, awaiting first report; cites pre-close June 30 holdings and an expected closing balance.
stale_evernorth_note.correction: The page's 'awaiting first report' status is stale against the October 30 SEC filing. The filing's 473M XRP is dated October 9, not a live current balance.

corrections.original_artifact_claim: The tracker has an internal product-count inconsistency because twelve products are described as six spot, four derivatives and one index.
corrections.corrected_claim: The displayed category counts sum to eleven while the search extract reports twelve products, but the missing category may be omitted from the extract. The direct page returned no readable lines. Companion-page AUM and volume differences are also search-extract observations, not verified same-cutoff measurements. Preserve as unresolved and model-ineligible; do not label a proven internal contradiction.

cross_provider_etf_window_reconciliation.interpretation: Both publishers show a zero November 4 session, but their multi-session aggregates differ. Thirty trading sessions are not the same window as a calendar month; seven sessions are not necessarily the same window as the publisher's past week. Publisher methodology and issuer-file timing also differ. Preserve each series separately and do not average.

reasons: The source captures are rendered pages, not byte-complete original issuer/AP payloads.
No independent timestamp anchors or exact per-source retrieval timestamps were captured.
Maketo and Alpha Finance use differently labelled rolling windows and publisher calculation series.
CorpStacking's headline fund universe cannot be fully reconciled from its gated table.
TheXRPInvestor direct page was unreadable; only search-result snippets were available.
